Did fairly well watching calories this week considering I ate out for 4 dinners. My average daily caloric intake during the week was 1494 cal. I met my goal of consuming between than 1200-1800 cal every day, except for one night when we went to the farm. It rained there earlier in the week so we decided to not camp and just make a day trip to the farm instead. Then we didn't need to plan meals or haul all our gear if the road was impassable(which it was). I did expect to go over when we made it a day trip since we always stop at this one buffet in the town nearby that I've been to numerous times throughout my life. Good country food with barbeque and desserts. With the buffet, I only had 1896 cal and spent a few hours hiking around and shooting guns so I'm not worried about going over that day. This week really was not bad, I managed to either get good choices at the different restaurants or eat a light lunch to leave room. It looks like I can eat out often if I am careful about my choices. My father is retiring this week so there'll probably be another night out somewhere.

According to my logging site, I've used 6669 more cal than I ate for the week. This should translate to 1.9 lbs. of real weight lose.

I went for a run 3 times this week. I did 3.1 mi in 30:28. That is another new record for me. I came really close to my goal but couldn't quite make it. I hope to make it before or at the race. My other times for running were 57:00 for 4 mi and 17:23 for 1.2 mi. One was really late and I just wasn't up for running much and the other was with my friend. I'll talk a lot with him while on the treadmill so I can't control my breathe well and I get distracted while walking. I also lifted weights twice this week. I bumped my overhead press back down and failed again at 60 lbs. I also failed my deadlift at 145 lbs. Both OHP and deadlift were done on the same day. My assisted pull-up/dips are getting lighter, down to a 18 lbs assist. I don't think that I can do these unassisted by the 5k. The assist is so light now that I barely feel it.

Failures:

* Went over cal limit one day

Exercises:

* Running: 30:28 - 3.1 mi, 17:23 - 1.2 mi, 57:00 - 4 mi * Squat: 110 lbs - 5x5, 115 lbs - 5x5 * OHP: 60 lbs - 4:5:3:5:3 * Deadlift: 145 lbs - 4 * Bench: 80 lbs - 5x5 * Row: 90 lbs - 5x5

The Half Mudder is now 7 weeks away. My goals for it are to be able to run 5 miles in an hour without feeling terrible, and to be able to perform 5 reps of pull-ups and dips. As my body fat goes down, these should become easier. My 5k is on Saturday. I want to be able to run a 5k in 30 minutes by the end of March.

I beat my previous 5k record by a minute, again. I think that my goal is aggressive, but achievable. I probably just need to eat a good meal a hour or two before running to achieve it. I'm happy with my progress on the assisted pull-up/dips machine but it had slowed down. Ideally, by my birthday in late April, I should be able to do 5 pull-up & dips without any assistance and complete that goal but I hope to achieve this by the 5k run.
